summary: AMC Entertainment Holdings filed an 8-K reporting that holders of $155.8M principal amount of Senior Secured Exchangeable Notes due 2030 (issued by subsidiary Muvico) exercised voluntary exchange rights. AMC will issue ~129.7M shares of Class A common stock to settle $142.2M of notes on May 5, 2026, with an additional ~12.4M shares reserved for the remaining $13.6M once ownership limitations are cleared. The exchange effectively converts debt into equity, reducing leverage but diluting existing shareholders significantly. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the transaction is governed by the indenture. Watch for continued dilution and potential price pressure from overhang of additional shares.
